policy.saplingRule: only Thoughtseed-originated ventures may be Saplings
policy.branchRule: client-originated work remains a Client Branch even when new
policy.programRule: shared company tooling, capability infrastructure, brand systems, and operator surfaces remain Internal Programs
policy.excludeRule: temporary checkouts, cleanup archives, external vendor clones, and unowned dependency references do not become WorkObjects

reviewNotes: The existing `panaroma-webapp` root-map row also mentions `branch:airdronauts-panorama-viewer-delivery`; later mapping should split or merge those records deliberately rather than duplicate active work.
